item.title: Crime Response, Shirley Crash Survivor, One Tax Bahamas
item.ns0:title: Crime Response, Shirley Crash Survivor, One Tax Bahamas
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the Commissioner of Police addresses a deadly weekend of gun violence in New Providence and details the strong case built in the tragic death of a missing Eleuthera woman. We break down the newly released 2026 National Examination results as officials flag worrying trends in core subjects, while the sole survivor of the devastating Shirley Street crash speaks out for the very first time. Plus, school union tensions simmer as teachers return to classrooms while waiting on a crucial government response, and calls mount for BPL to compensate residents and businesses hit by crippling power outages. Join us for these headlines, your complete sports report, and an active tropics update in our weather center!
